prose:
Yahoo republishes Madison Mills' Axios report about internal concern at Anthropic and OpenAI over safe release of advanced unreleased models. It retains the account of more than two dozen sources, debate over training and access, and company statements that safety work may slow development or release.

This is syndicated coverage of the [same Axios reporting](../summaries/68691d358a2f.md), not an independent second investigation corroborating every claim. Internal assessments are not a public evaluation proving universal loss of control. Debated restrictions are distinct from an enacted ban, and keeping a model internal is not presented as automatically safe.
highlights: Source count is more than two dozen
No industry-wide training or release halt is established
